name: Compact VLM Surveillance Anomaly Benchmark
description: Measures clip-level anomaly detection performance on surveillance video using compact vision-language models under weak supervision.
evaluation_method: AUC (ROC) and Average Precision / F1 for clip-level anomaly detection
reputation: Specialized benchmark for compact vision–language models in surveillance anomaly detection; currently of niche interest with limited adoption.
notes: Weak supervision makes labels noisy and evaluation less straightforward; domain-specific surveillance data may limit generalization; small/model-specific setups (compact VLMs) and potential pretraining/contamination risks should be considered.
